name: text_stated_years
what: A text_stated quote states several years but the resolver serves fewer of them
rule_id: OPEN (needs a resolver rule: serve every year a read's quote states)

name: coarser_duplicate
what: The same figure is tagged twice in one filing at different decimals and the coarser one is served
rule_id: OPEN in the resolver (display_cert 4bf4f69e prefers the finer fact; X116 covers amortization only)
examples: WMT FY2023 ShortTermBorrowings 372M dcml -6 vs 400M dcml -8

name: share_scale
what: A share count is off by 10^3 or 10^6 against net income / basic EPS

name: round_share_count
what: An undimensioned share count that is an exact multiple of 100M

name: comparative_only_year_hidden
what: A hidden year that a later 10-K or 10-Q prints as a comparative column

name: own_10k_year_hidden
what: A hidden year whose own 10-K presents the row's element for that year

name: line_double_count
what: One printed line serves two data points that are neither the same figure nor a total and its part
rule_id: OPEN (needs a resolver rule: one line one data point outside SAME_FIGURE/CONTAINS)
examples: COST FY2022 SG&A line as both sga_expense and operating_expenses

name: derived_without_parts
what: A shown derived value without one-filing printed parts
rule_id: display_cert.check_badges + gate (verifier only); doc 02 one filing per derivation
examples: GOOG gross_profit FY2015 DERIVED with no parts
